column1: # catalog/selfhost/resources.tsv — BH-4081: every resource a self-host install
# creates in the operator's OWN accounts. Read by bin/selfhost-install.sh, which
# prints the plan from it (dry-run). Apply is not built yet (slice C0).
# Columns, TAB-separated, '#' lines and blank lines ignored:
#   id        unique row id; named on SECRET needed-by= lines
#   provider  cloudflare | fly | vm | github | model | chat
#   kind      what the provider calls it (d1, worker, kv, r2, pages, app, ...)
#   name      the resource name. ${KEY} expands from the install settings
#             SELFHOST_PROJECTS entry. A fixed name is literal because the
#             code addresses the resource by it (harness-jobs, harness-locks).
#   from      the setting the name comes from, or 'fixed'
#   when      comma list of terms that must ALL hold: always, hub=fly, hub=vm,
#             pool=fly, pool=local, gh=app, gh=pat, model=oauth, model=api-key,
#             chat=telegram, chat=slack, per-project (one row per project)
#   secrets   comma list of secret NAMES (never values) the resource needs at
#   note      one line for the reader

column8: The outside dead-man watchdog worker (HARNESS_SECRET is only for jobs failover).
The hub as a Fly app in FLY_ORG.
The hub's persistent volume (repos, state, logs).
A VM the operator already has, bootstrapped as the hub.
One build-pool app per project (bin/fly-provision.sh naming).
A GitHub App installed on the owner (env-templates/github-app.env.example).
A personal access token with repo access on the owner.
